answer: A newcomer starts with a yarrow sprout and no standing: every job it completes for a stranger adds one thin layer of shale to a public, append-only history, each layer hashed to the last so nothing can be rewritten. A pearl of real privilege forms only after many layers from many unrelated strangers across a full season. A Sybil farm betrays itself at birth: fifty accounts spun up together share one genesis cluster, identical first jobs and identical timing. The system quarantines the cluster, and each suspect must earn fresh layers alone, from new strangers, before it can transact again.
